lines.trans: Mr Chun Yuqiao, though I am only an administrative assistant, I spent six years studying production.
My biggest dream is to become a producer, no matter what price I have to pay.
Fans crowdfunding a charity foundation is a wonderful topic, which is why I fought hard for it.
It was completed under your guidance, so it is bound to be the best proposal.
I beg you, please give me one chance!
Last time I accused you of improper conduct; I wronged you, yet you never said a word in defence.
Today, for the sake of this programme proposal, you have said all this to me.
Becoming a producer is what you care about most, is it not?
Through six years of study, and even longer, you have held onto just one goal.
I will give you a chance; at tomorrow's pitch meeting, compete fairly with everyone else.
Thank you, Mr Chun Yuqiao — nothing can stump Bu Xiaogu!
